L1.$comment: Semantic validation also checks unique IDs, references, ports, emitting output, cycles, dependency depth <=64 and executable blocks on the output path. Schema defaults are documentation; the evaluator uses the same registry defaults.

L2.title: QUANTSMART L2 indicator import
L2.$comment: References must resolve to existing L1 feature IDs; weights must exactly match selected keys and at least one must be positive. Overlay recipes/lines use the separate validated overlay contract. Palette blocks are not a JSON graph execution format.

L3.title: QUANTSMART L3 numeric formula import
L3.$comment: Canonical nested JSON uses explicit params. The importer also normalizes documented trailing constants, CONST/INPUT nodes and n-ary folds. Semantic validation enforces op-specific params, macro signatures, own references, no cycles, <=256 normalized nodes and depth <=64. A probability-like score is not a calibrated probability.

L4.title: QUANTSMART L4 condition import
L4.$comment: Metric scope, dependency availability and ordered range endpoints are validated by validateModule. role-specific weight/action semantics are preserved on import.

L5.title: QUANTSMART L5 condition import
L5.$comment: Metric scope, dependency availability and ordered range endpoints are validated by validateModule. role-specific weight/action semantics are preserved on import.

L6.title: QUANTSMART L6 reference zone import
L6.$comment: evidence requires an existing numeric L1/L2/L3 ID. L5-state anchors are unavailable. Swing anchors use the current and prior 20 bars; poc is range midpoint, not volume POC. L1 confirmed-pivot semantics are different.

L1.name: Body Ratio Feature
L1.explain: Measures candle body relative to its high/low range
L1.why: A geometry measurement; directional interpretation needs context
L1.explanation: Measure candle body divided by range; values near one indicate a larger body fraction.

L2.name: Trend-Vol Context
L2.explain: Combines EMA slope and ATR percentile as a trend-context input
L2.explanation: Weighted sum led by EMA slope, with ATR percentile and RSI context.

L3.name: Close-EMA over ATR
L3.explanation: (close − ema20) / atr: price deviation from EMA20 in ATR units.

L4.name: Trend-strength gate
L4.explain: Allows a candidate only when the configured EMA gap is sufficient

L5.name: Breakout-extension veto
L5.explain: Excludes a candidate extended too far beyond its 20-bar reference
L5.why: A location constraint; it does not predict whether a retest will occur

L6.name: Swing-low demand zone
L6.explain: A reference band around a recent swing low
L6.explanation: Demand reference band anchored to a swing low; visualization only.
